label: BMW16_S8_DEVELOPMENT_FAILURES_TEST_ONLY
scope: Implementation and audit-tool bring-up failures; none is an algorithm sample removed from the final matrix.

events.cause: fixture writer appended the two literal characters backslash+n after the JSON array
events.resolution: rewrote fixture with an actual newline and verified exactly 64 signed-int32 values
events.classification: fixture formatting error; T and party processes did not run

events.cause: S4 still emits four local dummy-only trace layers for the singleton while the endpoint uses a one-phase no-shuffle shortcut
events.resolution: auditor now verifies all four causal trace layers, zero FSS slots, and the single final network phase
events.classification: audit-tool model error; no protocol run was rejected
